high_level_description: The image shows the exterior of a Yes Bank branch at night. The bank's logo, "YES BANK," is prominently displayed on the top of the building in white text against a blue background with red checkmarks. The entrance to the bank is illuminated by interior lights, which cast a warm glow through the glass doors. Inside, there are several people standing near the counter, seemingly engaged in transactions or waiting for service. On the left side of the image, a vertical sign with the words "YES BANK" is lit up in purple neon lights, adding a modern touch to the scene.
